title: Anekanta paper result
description: One method's result for one cited work and one citing work. An export can contain one JSON object per line. Reconcile methods before counting distinct works or occurrences.

parameters.description: Search settings used by this method.

version.description: Extractor version, annotation protocol revision, or API version.

source.description: Exact input used by this method. Record the SHA-256 of the PDF bytes or the saved provider response. Relative PDF paths use the acquisition manifest directory or its explicit source_root.

outcome.description: no_match means the method completed on this source and returned zero passages. It does not establish that the paper never cites the target.

passages.description: One item per occurrence in source order when known. Equal text at different markers remains separate. A provider snippet is a candidate until located in the original.

id.description: Stable namespaced identifier. Prefer a lowercase doi: identifier. Otherwise use an openalex:, arxiv:, s2:, or persistent local: catalog identifier. Keep the same work ID across methods and PDF versions.

pdf_page.description: One-based page containing the citation marker, or the note when used inside note.

id.description: Persistent key within this cited-work, citing-work, source, and method combination. Preserve it on reruns and input reordering. Use a source anchor or assigned identifier rather than an output row number.

quote.description: Words surrounding the citation, in reading order. Collapse layout whitespace and expand typographic ligatures. Keep inline author/year citations. A detached note marker may be stored separately.

marker.description: Visible marker in the body, including other works in a grouped citation.

review.description: source_checked means a reviewer checked the quotation, its location, and the link to the cited work in the original document.
